item.edgerunners.sandevistan.desc: Spinal implant. [V] - slows the world around you for 6 s.
item.edgerunners.monowire.desc: Wrist-mounted razor wire. [X] - whip everything in front of you.
item.edgerunners.kiroshi_optics.desc: Cyber-eyes. [B] - scan and highlight all life within 40 blocks, night vision.
item.edgerunners.reinforced_tendons.desc: Press jump in mid-air for a double jump. Greatly reduced fall damage.
item.edgerunners.gorilla_arms.desc: Bare-handed hits deal +7 damage and huge knockback.
item.edgerunners.mantis_blade.desc: Right-click to lunge forward. Hits cause bleeding.
item.edgerunners.immunosuppressant.desc: Lowers cyberpsychosis by 35 (not below the cyberware baseline).
item.edgerunners.ripperdoc_kit.desc: Sneak + right-click to remove all installed cyberware.
hud.edgerunners.title: NEURAL LINK
msg.edgerunners.whisper3: Is this body even yours anymore?
gui.edgerunners.hint: Put an implant in the slot
msg.edgerunners.need_ripperdoc: Cyberware is installed by a ripperdoc - use a Ripperdoc Chair
item.edgerunners.street_samurai.desc: Forearm armour with retractable arm blades that deploy in combat. +2 attack damage, faster attacks.
item.edgerunners.netrunner_rig.desc: Neural circlet, temple ports and a cyberdeck with swaying data cables. Abilities recharge 40% faster.
item.edgerunners.heavy_borg.desc: Heavy armour plating, chest reactor and back exhausts that open when sprinting. +6 armour, knockback resistance, slightly slower.
item.edgerunners.merc_arms.desc: Full anodised cyber-arms with a spinning wrist rotor and servo fingers. +10% speed, +1 damage, +2 hearts.
item.edgerunners.speedster.desc: Two-seat open-top wedge supercar with neon underglow.
item.edgerunners.cyber_bike.desc: Fast, nimble bike with glowing hubless wheels. Leans into turns.
tooltip.edgerunners.paint: Paint: %s (right-click the vehicle with a dye to repaint)
tooltip.edgerunners.vehicle_controls: WASD drive, Space handbrake/drift, Ctrl nitro, H horn, Sneak+right-click to pick up
msg.edgerunners.chair_busy: The chair is busy - an operation is in progress
item.edgerunners.smart_pistol.desc: Smart rounds curve toward the target nearest your crosshair.
item.edgerunners.shotgun.desc: Nine pellets per shell. Devastating up close.
item.edgerunners.tech_rifle.desc: Electromagnetic coil rifle: rounds pierce through every target in line.
tooltip.edgerunners.gun_controls: Right-click fire, [R] reload (or Sneak+right-click), uses Ammo
item.edgerunners.projectile_launcher.des: Forearm missile pod. [G] - two homing micro-missiles.
msg.edgerunners.barrage: Barrage: infinite ammo, double fire rate
tooltip.edgerunners.persona_use: Right-click to slot in (again to eject). [Z] - ability
hero.edgerunners.runner_kid.desc: Street kid with a military Sandevistan. Faster, Sandevistan lasts 50% longer.
hero.edgerunners.runner_kid.ability: [Z] Sandevistan Dash: blink 9 blocks forward, cutting through everyone in the way
hero.edgerunners.netrunner_girl.desc: Elite netrunner. Monowire +50% damage, abilities recharge 30% faster.
hero.edgerunners.netrunner_girl.ability: [Z] Quickhack Overheat: sets the target in your sights on fire, slows and weakens it
hero.edgerunners.gunner_girl.desc: Tiny trigger-happy merc with cyber arms. Guns +40% damage, reload twice as fast.
hero.edgerunners.gunner_girl.ability: [Z] Barrage: 5 s of infinite ammo and double fire rate
hero.edgerunners.veteran_borg.desc: Crew leader with heavy cyber arms. +6 armour, +3 hearts, brutal punches.
hero.edgerunners.veteran_borg.ability: [Z] Ground Slam: shockwave that hurls everything within 6 blocks
hero.edgerunners.chrome_tyrant.desc: Full-body conversion war machine. +12 armour, +8 hearts, slower; constant cyberpsychosis pressure.
